WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_daily_price
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_daily_price) AS across_rating_avg
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT AVG(ra.avg_daily_price) AS avg_daily_price,
       AVG(ra.avg_daily_price - oa.across_rating_avg) AS avg_above_across_rating_avg
FROM rating_averages ra
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE ra.avg_daily_price > oa.across_rating_avg;
